hebrewText: וְ/הִנֵּ֥ה שְׁתוּלָ֖ה הֲ/תִצְלָ֑ח הֲ/לוֹא֩ כְ/גַ֨עַת בָּ֜/הּ ר֤וּחַ הַ/קָּדִים֙ תִּיבַ֣שׁ יָבֹ֔שׁ עַל עֲרֻגֹ֥ת צִמְחָ֖/הּ תִּיבָֽשׁ

tokens.bdb: to push forward, in various senses (literal or figurative, transitive or intransitive)
tokens.kjv: break out, come (mightily), go over, be good, be meet, be profitable, (cause to, effect, make to, send) prosper(-ity, -ous, -ously).

tokens.bdb: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.

tokens.bdb: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strike (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.)
tokens.kjv: beat, ([idiom] be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

tokens.bdb: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
tokens.kjv: air, anger, blast, breath, [idiom] cool, courage, mind, [idiom] quarter, [idiom] side, spirit(-ual), tempest, [idiom] vain, (whirl-) wind(-y).

tokens.bdb: the fore or front part; hence (by orientation) the East (often adverbially, eastward, for brevity the east wind)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially
tokens.enLiteralWord: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially
tokens.explanation: the fore or front part; hence  the East (often adverbially

tokens.bdb: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
tokens.kjv: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).

tokens.bdb: to be ashamed, confused or disappointed; also (as failing) to dry up (as water) or wither (as herbage)
tokens.kjv: be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame(-fully), [idiom] utterly, wither (away).

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.

tokens.bdb: something piled up (as if (figuratively) raised by mental aspiration), i.e. a paterre
tokens.ptLiteralWord: something piled up  raised by mental aspiration)
tokens.enLiteralWord: something piled up  raised by mental aspiration)
tokens.explanation: something piled up  raised by mental aspiration)
tokens.explanationEn: something piled up  raised by mental aspiration)

tokens.bdb: a sprout (usually concrete), literal or figurative
tokens.kjv: branch, bud, that which (where) grew (upon), spring(-ing).
